name: cfb
description: CFB multiplayer card game iPhone PWA

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cfb/shared && npm run build -w @cfb/server && npm run build -w @cfb/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @cfb/shared && npm run build -w @cfb/shared && npm run test -w @cfb/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cfb/shared && npm run typecheck -w @cfb/server && npm run typecheck -w @cfb/client
